in-tg-recruitment.notes: Reader-only research, awaiting review. Official legacy homepage links the new TGPSC portal. Manager (Engineering) 04/OG/HM/2026 guide specifies 130 provisional HMWSSB vacancies, direct recruitment and Indian citizenship; foreign citizens do not meet this notice's nationality rule. Engineering qualification must be declared by 18 September 2026; citizenship cannot override age or qualifications. Original application dates 23 September–17 October 2026, close 5:00 PM, official timezone unknown. Paper I English/Telugu, Paper II English; Basic English syllabus is 10th-class standard, not a proficiency certificate. Local reservation is separate from nationality; other-state applicants receive no reservation. OTR registration alone is not an application. Permanent tenure unverified.
in-tg-recruitment.accessGap: New portal returned reader 403 but ordinary browser displayed current official notices; linked 42-page Manager guide, brief web note and 21 September syllabus clarification were readable through web research. Browser access does not clear previous non-text robots response, scheduled collector permission or health. Originals and amendment reconciliation remain unretained/unreviewed. Departmental tests, cancellation notices and selection results are not fresh unrestricted job applications. No new cycle, health timestamp, venue pin or accepted eligibility result.
